description: Daily DEX swap volumes on Ethereum — Uniswap V2/V3, Curve, Balancer

params.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', block_timestamp) AS time, protocol AS protocol, COUNT(*) AS swap_count, SUM(amount_usd) AS volume_usd FROM ethereum.defi.dex_swaps WHERE block_timestamp >= '{start_time}' AND block_timestamp < '{end_time}' AND amount_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
